title: Touch UI
description: Disables controller mode, routes Input.touchCount / GetTouch to the legacy touch provider and gives Input's mouse and keyboard natives, and Input.GetAxis / GetAxisRaw for the "Mouse ScrollWheel" axis (the combat camera's zoom), to Touchscreen Mode's touchpad and keys, and, in Touch pointer mode (DM_POINTER_MODE=touch), hides the game's cursor by replacing Cursor.SetCursor and Cursor.set_visible, and lets the inventory lists (combat pages, key pages, burning books, passive succession) scroll by dragging, and runs the hover of a combat page in the hand that is pressed before it (so a tap selects it at once)

aeea627ddbd1214764dfef5f965e94a2.reason: il2cpp icall resolver (0x391660) success path, before ldr x19,[sp,#0x10]: x19 = the icall name, x0 = the resolved native; the host swaps x0 for its own mouse functions when the name is one of Input's mouse natives

BattleDiceCardUI.OnPdSubmit entry (OnPointerDown branches here): x0 = the combat page in the hand; GetClickableState refuses the press while _bEntered (+0x133) is false, so a finger that lands and presses in one frame is ignored; the host runs the hover (ShowDetail) first
